inventory.sourceFigureDescription: COLOR-CODED TABLE, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM-read at 120dpi, staging-ph27/vlm-census.txt — VLM available this session): page banner (252 / SECTION II / PHARMACOLOGY / PHARMACOLOGY-MISCELLANEOUS printed twice: running header + standalone sub-banner), the table title 'Drug names' in bold blue, column headers ENDING / CATEGORY / EXAMPLE, and 32 rows under three full-width shaded group-band rows — ANTIMICROBIAL (13): -asvir NS5A inhibitor Ledipasvir; -bendazole Antiparasitic/antihelminthic Mebendazole; -buvir NS5B inhibitor Sofosbuvir; -cillin Transpeptidase inhibitor Ampicillin; -conazole Ergosterol synthesis inhibitor Ketoconazole; -cycline Protein synthesis inhibitor Tetracycline; -floxacin Fluoroquinolone Ciprofloxacin; -mivir Neuraminidase inhibitor Oseltamivir; -navir Protease inhibitor Ritonavir; -ovir Viral DNA polymerase inhibitor Acyclovir; -previr NS3/4A inhibitor Grazoprevir; -tegravir Integrase inhibitor Dolutegravir; -thromycin Macrolide Azithromycin. ANTINEOPLASTIC (7): -case Recombinant uricase Rasburicase; -mustine Nitrosourea Carmustine; -platin Platinum compound Cisplatin; -poside Topoisomerase II inhibitor Etoposide; -rubicin Anthracycline Doxorubicin; -taxel Taxane Paclitaxel; -tecan Topoisomerase I inhibitor Irinotecan. CNS (12): -flurane Inhaled anesthetic Sevoflurane; -apine, -idone Atypical antipsychotic Quetiapine, risperidone; -azine Typical antipsychotic Thioridazine; -barbital Barbiturate Phenobarbital; -benazine VMAT inhibitor Tetrabenazine; -caine Local anesthetic Lidocaine; -capone COMT inhibitor Entacapone; -curium, -curonium Nondepolarizing neuromuscular blocker Atracurium, pancuronium; -giline MAO-B inhibitor Selegiline; -ipramine, -triptyline TCA Imipramine, amitriptyline; -triptan 5-HT1B/1D agonist Sumatriptan; -zepam, -zolam Benzodiazepine Diazepam, alprazolam. The ENDING column prints bold blue (not red); four rows carry paired endings with paired examples. No figures, icons, margin notes, or mnemonics.

notes: The topic carries TWO visual assets — the book-252 'Drug names' table (sv1, 32 rows in 3 clusters) and the book-253 'Drug names (continued)' table (sv2, 32 rows in 4 clusters) — both accounted for as ORIGINAL KYP ADAPTATIONS: nothing is reproduced; ONE registry visual (drug-name-map, DrugNameMap in visuals/pharm-p27.tsx, viewBox 0 0 1102 1216) rebuilds the two-page table's every row as original KYP vector art (sv1 → the Zone B left column's Antimicrobial/Antineoplastic/CNS bands + the Zone C -vir panel; sv2 → the Zone B right column's Autonomic/Cardiovascular/Metabolic/Other bands + the Zone C gli- panel), with the three-scan decode protocol (Zone A), the -mab/-cept humanization-code bridge marked beyond this page (Zone C card 3), and the sound-alike collision strip (Zone D); both pages' text is additionally carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. Census: zero raster images on both pages (pdfimages); VLM available this session — TWO 120dpi full-page glm-4.6v passes (vlm-census.txt) confirmed the printed row order of both pages, the seven shaded group bands, the bold-blue ENDING column, and the absence of -mab rows, monoclonal-antibody pointers, mnemonics, margin notes, and images; the brief's flagged worries were adjudicated (all reads agree): '5-HT1B/1D agonist' prints on ONE line (no split; the VLM's '5-IIT' is a serif misread adjudicated to the text layer), '-curium, -curonium' is the printed pair (the VLM's '-uronium' adjudicated), the CNS band covers 12 rows (the VLM's '14' is a miscount), and the -dipine Ca2+ superscript extracts out of order in the raw text layer (joined as printed).
